title: 污染土壤氣相抽除~Soil-vapor extraction
focus: 用真空、氣相通量與反彈證據判讀非飽和土壤氣相抽除~Interpret unsaturated-zone vapor extraction through vacuum, gas mass flux and rebound
summary: 本課以「用真空、氣相通量與反彈證據判讀非飽和土壤氣相抽除」為主軸，依序處理污染概念模型與非飽和帶、含水率與氣相連通、質量移除與稀釋判別、尾氣處理介質突破、觀測網與證據缺口。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Interpret unsaturated-zone vapor extraction through vacuum, gas mass flux and rebound, progressing through Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Moisture and gas connectivity, Mass removal versus dilution, Off-gas media breakthrough, Monitoring network and evidence gaps. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 污染概念模型與非飽和帶~Conceptual site model and vadose zone
units.mechanism: 先畫水位、透氣層、低滲透夾層與揮發源；氣相抽除依賴可連通的氣體孔隙，不能把飽和水體當成同一介質。 氣相孔隙體積除抽氣量是名目換氣尺度；含水增加同時會改變氣相連通性與滲透性。~Map the water table, permeable layers, low-permeability lenses and volatile source; extraction relies on connected gas pores rather than treating saturated water identically. Air-filled pore volume divided by extraction flow gives a nominal exchange scale; rising moisture also changes connectivity and gas permeability.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.
units.verify: 針對「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Conceptual site model and vadose zone, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「污染概念模型與非飽和帶」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Conceptual site model and vadose zone flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氣相孔隙體積減半就保證整治時間減半。~Halving air-filled pore volume guarantees halving cleanup time.
units.practice: 只將 na 改成 0.10，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1 h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only air-filled porosity na to 0.10, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1 h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 分層試抽與氣量配置~Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation
units.mechanism: 逐井比較氣流和真空回應，把快速吸入地表空氣的井與穿過污染區的井區分。 抽除質量率等於氣量乘濃度；稀釋可降低濃度而沒有提高污染物移除。~Compare well-specific flow and vacuum, separating rapid surface-air intrusion from paths through contamination. Removal mass rate equals gas flow times concentration; dilution can lower concentration without increasing removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽氣 Q=80 m³/h；污染物 C=25 mg/m³；同一乾濕與溫壓基準。公式 m=Q*C/1000，計算得 2 g/h。適用邊界：準穩態且基準一致，不含管路冷凝或吸附損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Extraction Q=80 m³/h; pollutant C=25 mg/m³ on matching moisture, temperature and pressure bases. Formula m=Q*C/1000 gives 2 g/h. Applicability: Quasi-steady conditions and consistent bases, excluding line condensation and sorption losses.
units.verify: 針對「分層試抽與氣量配置」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「分層試抽與氣量配置」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Layered pilot extraction and flow allocation flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 提高抽氣量總會按相同比例提高實際污染物移除率。~Increasing extraction always increases actual pollutant removal in direct proportion.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 120 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 3 g/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 120 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 3 g/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 含水率與氣相連通~Moisture and gas connectivity
units.mechanism: 在剖面上提高含水率，觀察氣相體積減少與可用路徑被截斷的不同影響。 氣相孔隙體積除抽氣量是名目換氣尺度；含水增加同時會改變氣相連通性與滲透性。~Increase moisture in the section and distinguish loss of gas volume from interruption of connected pathways. Air-filled pore volume divided by extraction flow gives a nominal exchange scale; rising moisture also changes connectivity and gas permeability.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：非飽和土體 V=500 m³；氣相孔隙率 na=0.20；抽氣 Q=50 m³/h。公式 t=V*na/Q，計算得 2 h。適用邊界：固定流量、均勻氣相，忽略壓縮性；不以較短名目時間推定較好整治。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Unsaturated bulk volume V=500 m³; air-filled porosity na=0.20; extraction Q=50 m³/h. Formula t=V*na/Q gives 2 h. Applicability: Fixed flow and uniform gas phase, neglecting compressibility; a shorter nominal time does not establish better remediation.
units.verify: 針對「含水率與氣相連通」，量土壤含水、各深度真空與氣體濃度，尋找被飽和水或低滲透層隔離區。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Moisture and gas connectivity, Measure moisture, vacuum and gas concentrations by depth to locate zones isolated by water or low-permeability strata. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 水分上升可能令可抽氣孔隙變小卻加劇旁通。 在「含水率與氣相連通」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Rising moisture can reduce gas-filled pore volume while increasing bypass. Mark where this error can enter the Moisture and gas connectivity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 氣相孔隙體積減半就保證整治時間減半。~Halving air-filled pore volume guarantees halving cleanup time.
units.practice: 只將 na 改成 0.10，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1 h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only air-filled porosity na to 0.10, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1 h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 真空抽風機與能耗~Vacuum blower and energy demand
units.mechanism: 把井頭真空、管路阻力及處理設備壓降分開，使用工作曲線判讀氣量；高真空不必然有效覆蓋污染源。 風機軸功率近似流量乘壓升再除效率；阻力增加時不能假設風量與效率都不受影響。~Separate well vacuum, pipe resistance and treatment pressure drop; use the working curve because strong vacuum need not cover the source. Fan shaft power is approximately flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency; increasing resistance may also change flow and efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：風量 Q=1.5 m³/s；壓升 Δp=1200 Pa；假設效率 η=0.60。公式 P=Q*dp/eta/1000，計算得 3 kW。適用邊界：不可壓縮、固定效率的比較，不是風機曲線選型。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Airflow Q=1.5 m³/s; pressure rise Δp=1200 Pa; assumed efficiency η=0.60. Formula P=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives 3 kW. Applicability: An incompressible fixed-efficiency comparison, not fan-curve selection.
units.verify: 針對「真空抽風機與能耗」，量測風量、差壓與輸入功率，在同一運轉點核對效率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Vacuum blower and energy demand, Measure airflow, differential pressure and input power at the same operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 堵塞使壓降上升，若只提高風機轉速可能增加能耗而不解決配流。 在「真空抽風機與能耗」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Blockage raises pressure drop; speed increases may waste energy without correcting distribution. Mark where this error can enter the Vacuum blower and energy demand flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 風機功率只與風量有關，與管路阻力無關。~Fan power depends only on flow and not on duct resistance.
units.practice: 只將 Δp 改成 1800 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變成 4.5 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Δp to 1800 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3 to 4.5 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 質量移除與稀釋判別~Mass removal versus dilution
units.mechanism: 配對同時刻流量與濃度並積分，不以濃度單獨下降宣布整治成功。 抽除質量率等於氣量乘濃度；稀釋可降低濃度而沒有提高污染物移除。~Pair concurrent flow and concentration and integrate removal rather than declaring success from concentration decline alone. Removal mass rate equals gas flow times concentration; dilution can lower concentration without increasing removal.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽氣 Q=80 m³/h；污染物 C=25 mg/m³；同一乾濕與溫壓基準。公式 m=Q*C/1000，計算得 2 g/h。適用邊界：準穩態且基準一致，不含管路冷凝或吸附損失。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Extraction Q=80 m³/h; pollutant C=25 mg/m³ on matching moisture, temperature and pressure bases. Formula m=Q*C/1000 gives 2 g/h. Applicability: Quasi-steady conditions and consistent bases, excluding line condensation and sorption losses.
units.verify: 針對「質量移除與稀釋判別」，同步記錄流量及分析濃度，積分質量率並核對處理單元前後負荷。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Mass removal versus dilution, Record flow and concentration simultaneously, integrate mass rate and reconcile loads across off-gas treatment. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只以出口濃度降低判斷進度，可能把吸入清潔空氣視為整治。 在「質量移除與稀釋判別」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Concentration decline alone may mistake clean-air intrusion for remediation. Mark where this error can enter the Mass removal versus dilution flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 提高抽氣量總會按相同比例提高實際污染物移除率。~Increasing extraction always increases actual pollutant removal in direct proportion.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 120 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 3 g/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 120 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 3 g/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 脫附控制與長期拖尾~Desorption control and tailing
units.mechanism: 把快速抽出的氣相污染與固相緩慢釋放分開；遲滯模型是理解庫存的水土類比，不能直接當氣相分配公式。 線性平衡吸附使溶質平均遷移慢於水；吸附不是污染物破壞。~Separate rapidly extracted gas contamination from slow solid-phase release; the water-soil retardation model illustrates inventory and is not a gas-partition formula. Linear equilibrium sorption slows mean solute travel relative to water; sorption is not contaminant destruction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾土體積密度 ρb=1.6 kg/L；Kd=0.5 L/kg；孔隙率 n=0.30。公式 R=1+rho_b*Kd/n，計算得 3.66667 dimensionless。適用邊界：線性、可逆、即時平衡吸附及固定密度孔隙率；不適用強非線性或非平衡拖尾。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry bulk density ρb=1.6 kg/L; Kd=0.5 L/kg; porosity n=0.30. Formula R=1+rho_b*Kd/n gives 3.66667 dimensionless. Applicability: Linear reversible instantaneous equilibrium sorption with fixed density and porosity; not strongly nonlinear or nonequilibrium tailing.
units.verify: 針對「脫附控制與長期拖尾」，用批次與柱試驗檢查 Kd 和濃度依賴性，將吸附物與溶解物總量守恆。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Desorption control and tailing, Check Kd and concentration dependence in batch and column tests and balance sorbed plus dissolved mass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把高遲滯因子解讀為已除污會漏掉未來脫附。 在「脫附控制與長期拖尾」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Interpreting high retardation as cleanup overlooks later desorption. Mark where this error can enter the Desorption control and tailing flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 被土壤吸附的污染物已從系統永久消失。~Sorbed contamination has permanently vanished from the system.
units.practice: 只將 Kd 改成 1.0 L/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.66667 變成 6.33333 dimensionless。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Kd to 1.0 L/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 3.66667 to 6.33333 dimensionless. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 尾氣處理介質突破~Off-gas media breakthrough
units.mechanism: 在數位流程加入吸附處理與前後端採樣，以介質突破和排出負荷追蹤轉移污染的去向。 容量除以污染負荷給名目耗盡時間；傳質、競爭離子及不可逆鈍化通常降低可用容量。~Add adsorption and upstream/downstream sampling to the digital flow and follow breakthrough and discharged load to track transferred contamination. Capacity divided by load gives nominal exhaustion time; mass transfer, competition and passivation often lower usable capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：介質質量 m=1000 kg；假設可用容量 a=0.02 kg/kg；污染輸入 L=0.25 kg/d。公式 t=m*a/L，計算得 80 d。適用邊界：固定負荷與已驗證可用容量，不推定真實突破日期。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Media mass m=1000 kg; assumed usable capacity a=0.02 kg/kg; pollutant loading L=0.25 kg/d. Formula t=m*a/L gives 80 d. Applicability: Constant loading and validated usable capacity; no real breakthrough date is implied.
units.verify: 針對「尾氣處理介質突破」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Off-gas media breakthrough, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「尾氣處理介質突破」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Off-gas media breakthrough flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 介質總質量相同時，不同水質下的使用壽命必定相同。~Equal media mass guarantees equal life in different water chemistry.
units.practice: 只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 停抽與重啟反彈~Shutdown and restart rebound
units.mechanism: 比較不同停機長度後的重啟曲線；本單元以水相濃度比作無因次示例，氣相資料也必須保持同一量測基準。 停機反彈可能反映低滲透區釋放、脫附或持續源，不等於取樣錯誤。~Compare restart curves after different idle periods; the dimensionless example uses aqueous units and gas data likewise require matching measurement bases. Shutdown rebound may reflect low-permeability release, desorption or a continuing source, not merely sampling error.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：停機前濃度 C1=4 mg/L；重啟濃度 C2=10 mg/L。公式 rebound=C2/C1，計算得 2.5 ratio。適用邊界：同一位置與方法的濃度比；不由此比值直接辨識唯一根因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Pre-shutdown concentration C1=4 mg/L; restart concentration C2=10 mg/L. Formula rebound=C2/C1 gives 2.5 ratio. Applicability: Concentration ratio at the same location and method; it does not identify a unique cause.
units.verify: 針對「停抽與重啟反彈」，保留停機時間與多次重啟趨勢，對照水位、流量和空白樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Shutdown and restart rebound, Retain shutdown duration and repeated restart trends, comparing heads, flows and blanks. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只報運轉中的低濃度會掩蓋未移除的污染庫存。 在「停抽與重啟反彈」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Reporting low on-treatment values alone hides residual contaminant inventory. Mark where this error can enter the Shutdown and restart rebound flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 設備運轉時濃度低就證明停機後也永遠保持低濃度。~Low concentration during treatment guarantees permanently low concentration after shutdown.
units.practice: 只將 C2 改成 7 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.5 變成 1.75 ratio。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only restart C2 to 7 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.5 to 1.75 ratio. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 觀測網與證據缺口~Monitoring network and evidence gaps
units.mechanism: 在源區、邊界和低滲透層配置教學採樣格，標出抽氣井附近以外的未驗證區域。 網格數需向上取整；空間覆蓋與熱點偵測機率是不同的採樣設計問題。~Place teaching sample cells at the source, boundary and low-permeability zones and mark unverified areas away from extraction wells. Grid counts round upward; spatial coverage and hotspot detection probability are different sampling-design questions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：抽樣區域 A=10000 m²；每格面積 a=400 m²。公式 N=ceil(A/a)，計算得 25 sample cells。適用邊界：規則平面網格計數，未指定法規採樣密度或統計信賴。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Survey area A=10000 m²; grid-cell area a=400 m². Formula N=ceil(A/a) gives 25 sample cells. Applicability: Regular planar-grid counting, not a regulatory density or statistical confidence claim.
units.verify: 針對「觀測網與證據缺口」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Monitoring network and evidence gaps, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「觀測網與證據缺口」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Monitoring network and evidence gaps flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 樣本平均值低就代表每個未採樣位置也都低。~A low sample mean proves every unsampled location is also low.
units.practice: 只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 階段交接與停止條件~Phase handoff and stopping evidence
units.mechanism: 整理捕獲、移除質量、反彈和資料有效性；設備在線率只用於交代試驗可靠性，不是清理完成指標。 可用率描述指定期間能工作的時間比例，並不等於合格產出率。~Combine capture, removed mass, rebound and data validity; equipment availability documents trial reliability rather than cleanup completion. Availability is the working-time fraction over a specified period, not the compliant-output fraction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：總計畫時數 T=1000 h；停機 t=60 h。公式 availability=(T-t)/T*100，計算得 94 %。適用邊界：明確定義計畫時間與停機分類；未納入性能降額或品質不合格。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Scheduled time T=1000 h; downtime t=60 h. Formula availability=(T-t)/T*100 gives 94 %. Applicability: Defined scheduled time and downtime categories; derating and rejected output are excluded.
units.verify: 針對「階段交接與停止條件」，對照事件紀錄、備援切換和品質資料，分開統計不可用及不合格時間。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Phase handoff and stopping evidence, Compare event logs, backup switching and quality data, separating unavailable and nonconforming periods. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 設備在線但數據失效或處理不合格時，不能當作完整有效服務。 在「階段交接與停止條件」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~An online unit with invalid data or nonconforming treatment is not fully effective service. Mark where this error can enter the Phase handoff and stopping evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 可用率 100% 就能保證所有產出或量測都合格。~One hundred percent availability guarantees all output and measurements conform.
units.practice: 只將 t 改成 90 h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 94 變成 91 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only downtime to 90 h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 94 to 91 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
